caption: The photograph path is the worked example followed through: 1200 × 800 pixels at 0.5 byte per pixel gives 480,000 bytes, that is 480 kB. The logo goes to PNG or SVG because it needs transparency and stays sharp at any size.

spec.title: Choosing a format and estimating size
spec.aria: A flowchart from a web page: the 1200 by 800 photograph goes to JPEG, then 960,000 pixels, 480,000 bytes and 480 kB, while the 200 by 200 logo goes to PNG or SVG for transparency.
